test_speed_videoseal_model: test the speed of embedding and extraction for a Videoseal model on a given dataset
run_speed_benchmark_cli: run the speed benchmark CLI to evaluate watermark embedding and extraction performance across multiple checkpoints
create_speed_tester_instance: create a SpeedTester instance to benchmark model embedding and extraction timing on CPU or CUDA
summarize_speed_test_results: summarize speed test results as a CSV DataFrame with per-frame and aggregate timing metrics
review_speed_tester_test_speed: review the SpeedTester.test_speed method that measures embedding and extraction latency with warmup and repeated runs
